final_payload.rationale_summary: The four daily 5-year CMT yields for 1972-03-07 through 1972-03-10 were retrieved. The growth rates for 03-07→03-08, 03-08→03-09, and 03-09→03-10 were calculated as 0.352112676..., 0.701754386..., and 1.219512195... respectively. The mean of the first two interval growth rates is 0.526933531..., so the 03-09→03-10 growth exceeded that mean by 0.692578664..., making 03-09→03-10 the higher reference.
